scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A zero-entropy system without a smooth positive-volume model” (preprints/A-finite-entropy-system-without-a-smooth-positive-volume-model-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 152 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 67d6dd8619de6c6f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exists an ergodic invertible measure-preserving transformation (X, µ, T) of a standard nonatomic probability space such that hµ(T) = 0 and (X, µ, T) is not measurably conjugate, on invariant conull sets, to any C∞ diffeomorphism of a compact finite-dimensional manifold preserving a strictly positive smooth probability density. The manifold may have smooth boundary and need not be orientable.
